budget.scope (A2 charges fixtures and the timing smoke to the same cap)

environment: results/env/torch_env.json (torch 2.14.1+cpu, numpy 2.4.6, Python 3.11.15, CPU, 1 thread; venv .venv-p5 not committed)
fixtures: results/env/fm_fixtures_run.json: tests/test_fm_adapter.py executed under torch before this amendment was written
d2_clarification: A single Adam over the four independent MLPs is not an error in general: with gradients reset to None (the zero_grad default since torch 2.0) Adam skips untouched networks. The A1 contract depended on that None-vs-zero distinction; per-network optimizers make the isolation explicit. D2 is a clarification, not a bug fix. D1 (shared role mask) stands as a defect fix.

dev_loss_rule.quantity: held-out dev flow-matching loss per pattern, with FIXED (x0, t) noise from the dev-loss seed, evaluated at 18000 and 20000 updates (90% and 100%)
dev_loss_rule.flag: UNDERTRAINING_FLAG for the arm if rel_decrease > 0.02 for any pattern
dev_loss_rule.role: diagnostic of optimization progress and stability only; it never makes an arm FAIL or INVALID; the checkpoint stays the final iterate; it is a loss, not a generative-quality score

levels.rule: fixed before the run, kept regardless of outcome; no level is chosen by any dev or test outcome

solver_sensitivity.pairing: both levels use the same examples, the same initial noise and the same intermediate draws: the sampling seed keys do NOT contain the step count (this supersedes A1 'solver.seeds'); only the permutation keys carry the step count
solver_sensitivity.statistic: per-example difference d_i = ED_U(128)_i - ED_U(32)_i (standardised) at each level and split; mean with the paired normal 95% CI from the sd of d_i over examples; the same for the quality metric
solver_sensitivity.no_independent_se_sum: the A1 rule |T_fine - T_coarse| <= 1.645 x sqrt(se_fine^2 + se_coarse^2) is withdrawn: it had no stated hypothesis or level and it treated the two levels as independent
solver_sensitivity.flag: SOLVER_SENSITIVE for (arm, split, level) if the paired 95% CI of mean d_i excludes 0; then the arm's gap at that endpoint is marked NUMERICS_NOT_SEPARATED (numerical and learned components not separated); all numbers are still reported
solver_sensitivity.not_a_convergence_proof: agreement of the two levels does not prove ODE convergence; the tests concern the output law of the fixed solver, not the ideal continuous-time flow

inconclusive_label: MODEL_FIT_OR_NUMERICS_INCONCLUSIVE only if any training loss or any sample of the arm is non-finite
incomplete_budget: INCOMPLETE_BUDGET if the CPU or wall cap is reached before both arms are trained and evaluated on test; partial checkpoints and completed stages are saved and reported; no best-effort substitute is reported as a result

evaluation.examples: the 200 dev examples for the dev stage and the 200 test examples for the test stage (same rows as the GMM control run, regenerated from the data seed keys)
evaluation.design: Test P, N = 200, M = 64, B = 199, statistic mean ED_V on the standardised scale (y, z divided by train sds), upper tail; 8 fixed projection directions at the joint level
evaluation.branches: direct z|x vs sequential (fresh y from the arm's own y|x for every sample, then z|x,y); separate seed streams per branch; the observed y is never used; CFG off; base N(0, I)
evaluation.primary_family: the two FM target-level Test P p-values at 128 steps on the test split; Holm at alpha = 0.05; the GMM control p-values of round 4 are not part of this family

between_arm_effect.statistic: e_i = ED_U(SHARED)_i - ED_U(INDEPENDENT)_i at the target level, 128 steps, test split; mean with paired normal 95% CI; percentile bootstrap over examples (2000 resamples, seeded) as a check
between_arm_effect.direction: negative means the shared arm has the smaller estimated target gap
between_arm_effect.pairing: example-paired; samples are NOT paired across arms (each arm has its own noise streams keyed by the arm name)
between_arm_effect.unit: conditioning example; conditional on one model seed per arm
between_arm_effect.negative_values: ED_U is unbiased for a non-negative population distance and may be negative; it is not clipped
between_arm_effect.not_a_ranking: a larger p-value does not rank an arm as more coherent; one arm rejecting and the other not is not evidence of a difference

evaluation.quality_to_truth: unbiased sample energy distance between the 64 direct samples and the true conditional (closed-form cross and truth terms via the mixture formula; U-statistic within-sample term), standardised, per example; may be negative; this is NOT the closed-form population distance reported for the GMM controls and the two are not compared
evaluation.diversity: sd of the 64 direct z samples divided by the true conditional sd, per example
evaluation.cost: parameters, updates, pattern exposure (updates and rows), training wall-s and CPU-s, sampling and permutation wall-s and CPU-s per block, threads; similar parameters/updates do not mean equal FLOPs
evaluation.no_loglik: the flow arms have no computed density; no log-likelihood is reported for them
evaluation.controls: TRUE/FITTED results of round 4 are reused as reported; per-example control values were not stored, so no neural-vs-control paired comparison is made

budget.smoke: train-only timing smoke with run seed 999 (<= 60 CPU-s), used only to check that the fixed plan fits the remaining budget; not reported as a result

order: train INDEPENDENT then SHARED (final iterate, checkpoints hashed)
dev evaluation and labels written to disk
nothing changed after the test split is opened
stored: per-example results for both splits, levels and step counts
study_status: not an untouched study: the round-4 control results on the same test examples were seen before this run; the flow arms were not tuned on anything
dry_run: the smoke also runs the evaluation code path on 3 TRAIN conditioning values with 4/2 Euler steps (scratch only) to check the pipeline before any budgeted evaluation; its numbers are discarded

addenda_pre_run.registered: 2026-10-02, after an adversarial static review of the runner and before any flow-matching training; commit of A2 v1 = 22963ed
addenda_pre_run.streams: the per-example sampling keys and the permutation keys carry no split field (the registered seeds.sampling scheme of the base config, also used by the round-4 GMM run): dev example i and test example i draw the same initial noise, and the dev and test permutation tests of one (arm, level, steps) use the same allocation sequence; the dev stage is therefore not an independent Monte Carlo replicate of the test stage; no information flows from dev to test; arms and branches have separate streams; the between-arm bootstrap key does carry the split
addenda_pre_run.dev_tests: Test P is also run on dev (descriptive, chooses nothing); only the dev loss diagnostic, the solver-sensitivity flag and the non-finite check define labels
addenda_pre_run.label_after_test: a non-finite test sample re-labels the arm MODEL_FIT_OR_NUMERICS_INCONCLUSIVE after the fact (recorded as label_after_test in the manifest; the dev-time labels.json is not changed); a test block with non-finite examples reports its test on the finite examples with n_finite stated
addenda_pre_run.holm: Holm is applied over the fixed family of 2 tests; a member whose p cannot be computed counts as p = 1
addenda_pre_run.incomplete_vs_inconclusive: INCOMPLETE_BUDGET only when the update count is not reached or the cap stops a stage; a non-finite training loss does not stop the run and yields the INCONCLUSIVE label
addenda_pre_run.stop_rule_guard: the runner refuses to start if any prior output directory of this run exists under results/raw; a partial run is kept as it is
addenda_pre_run.failure_manifest: if the run fails for any other reason, a manifest with status FAILED and the budget spent is written before the error propagates
addenda_pre_run.budget_accounting: process CPU is counted from process start (torch import included) plus the CPU already charged (fixtures 2.1 s, smokes 6.9 s + 7.1 s); the wall cap is per invocation
addenda_pre_run.smoke: the smoke is training timing plus a sampling benchmark and a scratch dry run of the evaluation path on 3 train conditioning values; its 60 CPU-s bound is enforced; it ran before these addenda (see ledger)
addenda_pre_run.torch_seed_width: see results/env/seed_preflight.json: the CPU generator of the installed torch uses the low 32 bits of a seed; all effective 32-bit seeds of this run were checked for distinctness before the run
